title: Finite Q3 cubic multiplier stress for the energy-graph carrier
question: For the actual finite Q3 Hamiltonians, does the spatially weighted cubic multiplier f_x^(3/4) q_x^3 A_f^(-3/4) remain finite across source pairs, beta values and volumes, where A_f is the declared centered local-energy proxy?

energy_graph.bond_weight: (f_x+f_y)/2 times the canonical Q3 bond term
energy_graph.proxy: A_f=I+weighted onsite and bond Hamiltonian, shifted to the positive finite-matrix representative when truncation produces a negative eigenvalue

finite_fixture.distance_metric: shortest-path distance in the declared finite graph
finite_fixture.state_weighted_norm: four-leg Hilbert-Schmidt norm against the full-volume Gibbs square root

adversarial_review.check: A_f is a finite truncated energy proxy; no Friedrichs form or infinite CCR domain is inferred from its eigendecomposition.
The site factor is applied to both orientations and the graph distance is recomputed for every declared source pair; no unweighted moving-site claim is made.
Beta changes only the finite Gibbs four-leg diagnostic; the operator norm is kept separate and no beta-independent state is assumed.
All volumes and source pairs are finite declared cases; maxima are diagnostics and not a supremum or asymptotic theorem.
Even a finite PASS would not prove q^3 A^(-3/4) on the common core, the first-passage history, or thermodynamic Cauchy.
No common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A conclusion follows.

lean_crosscheck.boundary: Lean checks exact rational weight bookkeeping and the scope firewall only; matrix spectra, operator domains and QFT limits remain Python/open analysis.

qft_interface.closed: The primary and independent executable finite stress lanes, including the state-weighted four-leg rows, are closed for the declared source pairs, beta values and volumes.
qft_interface.open: A volume/source/beta-uniform cubic embedding, actual split-history recurrence, direct projected D and delta-D locality, exhaustion, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum and Pre-A remain open.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: No TECT production owner, heat_root_incidence, physical-empty reference or Sector-A closure is supplied.

no_overclaim: This package is a finite diagnostic for one spatially weighted energy-graph carrier. It neither proves nor disproves the analytic cubic multiplier embedding or any thermodynamic QFT construction; any growth is route-local only.
